source.author: verg
source.text: quales mugitus, fugit cum saucius aram taurus, et incertam excussit cervice securim.
source.text_original: quales mugitus, fugit cum saucius aram / taurus, et incertam excussit cervice securim.
source.text_english: as when a wounded bull flees the altar and, shaking off the uncertain axe with his neck, gives out such bellowings.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: clamores simul horrendos ad sidera tollit, quales mugitus, fugit cum saucius aram taurus .
reuse.text_original: clamores simul horrendos ad sidera tollit, quales mugitus, fugit cum saucius aram taurus .
reuse.text_english: At the same time he raises dreadful cries to the stars, like the lowing of a bull when wounded he flees the altar.
